title: Organic Crunchy Kenyan Vegetable Bowl
description: A herbal and crunchy monsoon Kenyan dish featuring epoisses and shio-cure, served in a lacquerware bowl, dairy-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped kale with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the kale mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 10 minutes or until crispy.
In a large pan, heat the dairy-free epoisses cheese alternative over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add the shio-cure seasoning, lemon juice, and grated carrots to the pan and stir until well combined.
Add the roasted kale to the pan and stir until the kale is evenly coated with the cheese mixture.
Top the kale mixture with crispy fried onions and chopped parsley.
Serve the organic crunchy Kenyan vegetable bowl in a lacquerware bowl.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
